# Mogeny LLC

> Mogeny LLC is a financial management firm in Chicago, Illinois, owned by Kamila Piotrowicz. It provides bookkeeping, financial management and reporting, controller and CFO services, family office and estate management, data-driven KPI analysis and forensic accounting for businesses and families in Chicago and remotely across the United States.

- Phone and text: (773) 964-2446
- Email: hello@mogeny.com
- Based in: Chicago, IL. Serves Chicago in person or remotely, and the rest of the US remotely.
- Pricing: set after an introductory call, with the scope and price confirmed in writing before work starts.
- Tax preparation is not one of the services Mogeny LLC offers.

## Services

- [Financial management and reporting](https://www.mogeny.com/services/financial-management-reporting/): Monthly financial statements, budgets and cash reports, with a plain explanation of what changed and why.
- [Bookkeeping](https://www.mogeny.com/services/bookkeeping/): Every transaction recorded, categorized and reconciled each month, plus catch-up work for books that have fallen behind.
- [Controller and CFO services](https://www.mogeny.com/services/controller-cfo-services/): Part-time senior finance oversight. A controller keeps the numbers right and a CFO plans cash, budgets and growth.
- [Family office and estate management](https://www.mogeny.com/services/family-office-estate-management/): Household, property and estate finances tracked, paid and reported in one place, alongside your attorney and advisers.
- [Data-driven KPI analysis](https://www.mogeny.com/services/kpi-analysis/): The few numbers that show how your business is doing, tracked every month and explained in plain words.
- [Forensic accounting](https://www.mogeny.com/services/forensic-accounting/): A close look at the records when money is missing, disputed or unexplained, with the findings set out in writing.
